why: Both propose the same focused home-lender hedgehog while recognising the company has not chosen one, and both name the rate squeeze, risk-taking deregulated peers and the legacy fixed-rate book. Analysis 2 edges ahead because its stop-doing list bars all further non-lending acquisitions rather than only the brokerage unit, and it names undisciplined diversification as the top decline risk, with triggers, a home-state housing downturn and an eventual sale.
